warnings: This community reconstruction has known omissions. It is not a certified Nasdaq-100 history.
CMCSK and LVNTA are missing. LILA and LILAK reentries from December 2016 to early 2018 are missing.
Effective dates are present, but publication timestamps are absent. Availability before the execution close is a modeling assumption.
Historical ticker labels are not stable security identifiers. Known unsafe date ranges are excluded, and ticker renames are not mapped automatically.
The identity exclusion list covers known hazards only. It does not certify every price series or corporate action.
Missing prices for renamed or delisted securities can still favor survivors. Membership data alone does not remove survivorship bias.
The dataset supplies neither index weights nor merger, spinoff, liquidation or cash-consideration terms.
2013-05-20: Maximum Sharpe uses Minimum volatility because no feasible portfolio has positive expected excess return.
11 allocation dates exclude at least one historical member. Review coverage.csv. Incomplete prices and membership records can still cause survivorship bias.

settings.execution: Use the effective roster on each trade date; fit through the prior close; execute at the next close. The first evaluation session is cash. Membership publication timestamps are not verified.
settings.departure_policy: Sell former members at the next scheduled trade, not on the membership change date.
settings.eligibility: Require a complete prior price window and no known identity ambiguity. Never inspect future prices for eligibility.
settings.cash_policy: Move fully to zero-interest cash when eligible members cannot meet the holding cap.
settings.cost_convention: Basis points per absolute dollar bought or sold; entry included; no final liquidation.

membership.source_provenance: Community reconstruction from Wikipedia component-change records, including upstream historical ticker corrections. Not Nasdaq-certified.
membership.date_convention: Each complete roster takes effect on its date, inclusively. Snapshots contain effective dates, not publication timestamps.
